title: Janitorial Walkthrough Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Janitorial Walkthrough: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Janitorial Walkthrough Inspection Checklist covers cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task. The facility cleaning coordinator records Janitorial Walkthrough criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Janitorial Walkthrough Inspection Checklist keeps Janitorial Walkthrough exceptions visible until the facility cleaning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Janitorial Walkthrough Inspection Checklist at occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones. Document cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task identity before Janitorial Walkthrough begins. Compare cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task findings with stated Janitorial Walkthrough criteria; route unresolved Janitorial Walkthrough issues to janitorial quality supervisor.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Janitorial Walkthrough, identify responsible parties, occupied rooms, restrooms, common areas, service closets, and restricted zones, and the linked cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task source.

fields.label: Scope standard, service level, and prior deficiency reference

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Janitorial Walkthrough facts for cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Janitorial Walkthrough inspection checks
items: Soil, residue, touchpoint, floor, and fixture condition
Waste, recycling, sharps, or special-stream handling
Chemical label, dilution, container, and storage condition
Room release, odor, damage, and recurring deficiency

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Before closing Janitorial Walkthrough, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Facility Cleaning Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Damaged surface or fixture outside cleaning scope
Restricted room or privacy boundary not cleared
Wet-floor or access control cannot be maintained
blocks.guidance: Pause Janitorial Walkthrough when an unknown exposure, restricted-area concern, public slip risk, or unresolved damage remains. Retain the available Janitorial Walkthrough proof and route unresolved cleaning zone, surface, fixture, supply point, waste stream, and service task scope to facility cleaning coordinator.
